rounds.lesson:
GOAL: Humne dekha ki electron cyclic raaste se laute ya non-cyclic raaste se aage jaaye, dono mein ATP banta hai; par electron ADP ko kabhi chhoota hi nahi, toh electron ki yeh daud ATP kaise bana deti hai?
MISAAL: Dam: thylakoid membrane dam ki deewaar, lumen mein jama H⁺ deewaar ke peeche roka hua paani, stroma neeche ki kam paani wali nadi, H⁺ ko lumen tak pahunchaane wale kaam paani chadhane wale pump, CF₀ deewaar ki nali aur turbine, CF₁ generator, aur ATP bani hui bijli.
LESSON
[p010-i14]
Humne dekha ki electron cyclic raaste se laute ya non-cyclic raaste se aage jaaye, dono mein ATP banta hai.
Par ek baat ajeeb hai. Electron toh carriers ke beech hi daudta raha, ADP ko usne kabhi chhooa hi nahi.
Toh aaj ka sawaal yeh hai ki electron ki yeh daud ATP kaise bana deti hai?
Is sawaal ka jawab ek vichaar deta hai, jise aaj hum dheere-dheere kholenge.
Pehle H⁺ ko yaad karo. Yeh positive charge wala hydrogen ion hai, jise proton bhi kehte hain.
Ab ek phoola hua gubbara socho. Uske andar hawa zyada hai aur bahar kam, isliye munh khulte hi hawa tezi se bahar bhaagti hai.
Kisi cheez ki maatra ek taraf zyada aur doosri taraf kam ho, toh is fark ko gradient kehte hain. Membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ki maatra ke fark ko proton gradient kehte hain.
Ab us vichaar ka naam suno: chemiosmotic hypothesis. Chemi yahan ATP banne ki chemical reaction ko batata hai, aur osmotic membrane ke aar-paar cheezon ke jaane ko.
Hypothesis ek jaanchne layak vichaar hota hai, jaisa Priestley ne hawa ke baare mein diya tha. Is vichaar ke hisaab se ATP banna membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ ke fark se juda hai.
Yeh vichaar Peter Mitchell ne 1961 mein diya tha, aur iske liye unhe 1978 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize mila.
Respiration mein ATP isi tarah banta hai, aur photosynthesis mein bhi ATP banna membrane ke aar-paar proton gradient banne se juda hai.
Yahan woh membrane thylakoid ki membrane hai. Yaad karo, thylakoid ek chapti thaili hai: uski deewaar membrane hai, andar ki jagah lumen, aur bahar ka fluid stroma.
Chloroplast mein ek fark hai: yahan H⁺ membrane ke andar ki taraf, yaani lumen mein, jama hote hain.
Ab respiration ki jagah dekho, yaani mitochondria. Mitochondria ki do membranes hoti hain, ek bahar wali aur ek andar wali.
Inter ka matlab hai beech. Dono membranes ke beech ki patli jagah ko intermembrane space kehte hain.
Respiration mein jab electrons ETS, yaani electron transport system, se guzarte hain, tab H⁺ isi intermembrane space mein jama hote hain.
Andar wali membrane ke bhi andar ki jagah, jise aage matrix kahenge, wahan yeh H⁺ jama nahi hote.
Respiration ka yeh hissa aage respiration padhte waqt khulega. Abhi itna yaad rakho: chloroplast mein lumen, aur mitochondria mein intermembrane space.
[analogy]
Is poore vichaar ko ek dam ki tasveer se samjho; yeh tasveer aaj ke poore safar mein hamare saath rahegi.
Nadi par ek oonchi deewaar bani hai, aur deewaar ke peeche bahut saara paani roka gaya hai.
Deewaar ke neeche wali nadi mein paani kam hai, isliye peeche ka paani neeche bahne ke liye zor lagata rehta hai.
Deewaar mein bas ek nali chhodi gayi hai, aur us nali mein ek turbine lagi hai.
Paani nali se girta hai toh turbine ghoomti hai, aur turbine se juda generator bijli banata hai.
Jalaashay bhara rahe, isliye kuch pump bhi lage hain, jo neeche ka paani uthakar deewaar ke peeche chadha dete hain; inhe chalane mein energy lagti hai.
Ab dekho, kaun kya hai. Dam ki deewaar thylakoid membrane hai, aur deewaar ke peeche roka hua paani lumen mein jama H⁺ hain.
Neeche ki kam paani wali nadi stroma hai, jahan H⁺ kam hain.
Paani chadhane wale pump electron transport ke woh kaam hain jo H⁺ ko lumen tak pahunchaate hain, aur unki energy light se aati hai.
Deewaar ki nali, turbine aur generator membrane mein lagi ek protein machine hai, aur bani hui bijli ATP hai.
Paani roke bina bijli nahi banti; isi tarah H⁺ ko lumen mein roke bina ATP nahi banta.
[p010-i15]
Dam mein pehle jalaashay bharna padta hai, tabhi turbine ghoomti hai. Thylakoid mein bhi pehla kaam lumen mein H⁺ jama karna hai.
Toh chalo, pehle samjhein ki yeh proton gradient banta kaise hai.
Iske liye light reaction mein electron ka safar ek baar phir dekhna hoga.
Yaad karo, light milne par electron zyada energy wali state mein pahunch jaata hai, yaani excited ho jaata hai.
Light ki energy se electron ke is tarah jaag uthne ko activation of electrons kehte hain.
Phir excited electron ek carrier se doosre carrier ko aage diya jaata hai; yahi uska transport hai.
Is safar ke kuch kadam aise hain jo membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ki ginti badal dete hain.
Aaj ka poora kaam do hisson mein hai: pehle gradient banta hai, aur phir gradient tootkar ATP banata hai.
Gradient banne ki teen wajahein milengi. Pehli, water splitting lumen mein H⁺ deti hai. Doosri, ek carrier stroma se H⁺ uthakar lumen mein chhodta hai. Teesri, NADP⁺ ki reduction stroma ke H⁺ kharch karti hai.
Teeno ko Figure 11.7 par dekhenge, jo electron aur H⁺, dono ka safar ek saath dikhata hai.
[p011-i1]
Ab Figure 11.7 par ungli rakho. Yeh thylakoid ki band thaili ka ek hissa hai, jise kaatkar dikhaya gaya hai.
Gulaabi patti Thylakoid membrane hai. Isi mein photosystems, electron carriers aur ATP banane wali machine lagi hain.
Patti ke andar Lumen (high H⁺) likha hai, kyunki yahan H⁺ zyada jama hote hain. Bahar Stroma (low H⁺) likha hai, kyunki wahan H⁺ kam reh jaate hain.
Ab Light ke orange teer dekho. Ek teer P680 wale PS II par padta hai, aur doosra P700 wale PS I par; PS yaani photosystem.
PS II ke paas H₂O se ½O₂ + H⁺ banta dikhaya hai, aur saath mein Oxidation of water likha hai.
Oxidation isliye likha hai, kyunki paani yahan electron deta hai. ½O₂ isliye, kyunki ek paani se oxygen ka ek hi atom milta hai, yaani aadha O₂ molecule.
Yeh H⁺ lumen ki taraf dikhaya gaya hai, aur paani ka electron PS II ki kami poori karta hai.
Ab electron ke saath chalo. PS II se electron PQ tak jaata hai, jiska poora naam Plastoquinone hai.
Plasto plastid se aaya hai, aur chloroplast ek plastid hi hai; quinone carbon wale compounds ka ek parivaar hai. PQ membrane ke andar hi ghoomne wala carrier hai.
PQ ke paas stroma se aata H⁺ ka teer dekho. H⁺ lekar PQ ka naam PQH₂ ho jaata hai; H₂ yahan do hydrogen judne ko batata hai.
Aage Cytochrome B6f hai. Cytochromes ko hum electron lekar aage dene wale proteins jaante hain, aur iske andar cytochrome b6 aur cytochrome f hote hain.
B6f ke paas ek H⁺ ka teer lumen ki taraf jaata hai; is teer ko abhi yaad rakho.
B6f se electron PC tak jaata hai, yaani Plastocyanin tak. Yeh lumen ki taraf ka chhota protein hai, jo electron ko P700 wale PS I tak pahunchata hai.
Plastocyanin mein copper hota hai, aur copper ki wajah se yeh neela dikhta hai; cyan ka matlab neela hi hai.
Light paakar PS I electron ko stroma ki taraf Fd tak bhejta hai. Fd yaani ferredoxin; ferre iron ko batata hai, kyunki is protein mein iron hota hai.
Fd se electron FNR tak jaata hai. FNR ka poora naam ferredoxin-NADP⁺ reductase hai, aur yahi woh NADP reductase enzyme hai jise hum pehle jaan chuke hain.
FNR ke paas NADP⁺ + H⁺ se NADPH banta dikhaya hai.
Ab daayi taraf dekho. Membrane ke aar-paar ek machine lagi hai, jis par ATP synthase likha hai; synthase ka matlab banane wala enzyme, toh yeh ATP banane wala enzyme hai.
Iska membrane mein dhansa hissa CF₀ hai, aur stroma ki taraf nikla sir CF₁ hai. CF₁ ke paas ADP + Pᵢ se ATP banta dikhaya hai.
Ab saare H⁺ labels gino: kuch lumen ke andar hain, kuch carriers ke paas, aur kuch hare teeron par, jo lumen ke H⁺ ko CF₀ aur CF₁ ke raaste stroma mein lautate hain.
Ek wedge bhi bana hai, yaani patla hota hua kona, jis par High Electrochemical Potential Gradient se Low tak likha hai.
Electro charge ko batata hai, aur chemical maatra ko. H⁺ positive hain, isliye lumen mein unki maatra bhi zyada hai aur positive charge bhi, aur High sira lumen mein hai, Low sira stroma mein.
Ek baat par gaur karo. Electron carriers se hota hua NADPH tak jaata hai, ADP tak kabhi nahi pahunchta, aur H⁺ alag teeron par chalte hain.
Membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ ke fark aur uske bahaav se ATP banne ko chemiosmosis kehte hain; isiliye is figure ka naam ATP synthesis through chemiosmosis hai.
[p010-i16]
Ab pehli wajah lo, yaani water splitting.
Yaad karo, water splitting PS II se judi hai, aur uski machine membrane ke andar wale chehre par, lumen ki taraf lagi hai.
Wahan do paani ke molecules tootkar chaar H⁺, ek O₂ aur chaar electron dete hain.
In H⁺ ke do naam hain, protons aur hydrogen ions. Hydrogen atom mein ek proton aur ek electron hota hai, aur electron nikal jaaye toh sirf proton bachta hai.
Isliye H⁺ ko hydrogen ion bhi kehte hain aur proton bhi; dono ek hi kan ke naam hain.
Jaisa humne dekha tha, paani lumen ki taraf tootta hai, isliye bane H⁺ seedhe lumen mein hi chhoot jaate hain.
Lumen chaaron taraf membrane se ghiri band thaili hai, isliye yeh H⁺ wahin jama hote jaate hain.
Dam ki tasveer mein yeh aisa hai, jaise jalaashay mein seedha barish ka paani gir raha ho; ise chadhane ke liye pump ki zaroorat hi nahi.
Toh pehli wajah yeh hai: water splitting membrane ki inner side par hoti hai, isliye usse bane protons, yaani hydrogen ions, thylakoid ke lumen mein jama hote hain.
[p011-i20]
Doosri wajah electron ke safar mein hi chhupi hai.
Yaad karo, reaction centre se nikla electron sabse pehle primary acceptor leta hai.
Yeh primary acceptor membrane ki bahar wali taraf, yaani stroma ki taraf, hota hai.
Ab dhyaan do, yeh apna electron kisi electron carrier ko nahi deta. Electron carrier sirf electron le jaata hai, jaise cytochrome B6f aur PC.
Yeh electron ek H carrier ko deta hai, jo electron ke saath ek H⁺ bhi utha leta hai.
Naam H carrier isliye hai, kyunki ek electron aur ek proton milkar ek hydrogen atom ke barabar hote hain; yeh carrier poora hydrogen dhota hai.
Electron lete waqt H carrier stroma ki taraf hota hai, isliye woh H⁺ bhi stroma se hi uthata hai.
Figure mein yahi H carrier PQ hai. Do electron aur stroma ke do H⁺ lekar woh PQH₂ ban jaata hai.
Phir PQH₂ membrane ke andar khiskta hua andar wali taraf ke electron carrier, cytochrome B6f, tak pahunchta hai.
Electron carrier sirf electron leta hai, H⁺ nahi. Isliye bacha hua H⁺ membrane ki andar wali taraf, yaani lumen mein, chhoot jaata hai.
Yahi B6f ke paas lumen ki taraf jaata H⁺ ka woh teer hai, jise humne figure mein yaad rakha tha.
Dam ki tasveer mein yahi pump hai, jo neeche ki nadi se paani uthakar deewaar ke peeche daal deta hai.
Yahan H⁺ kam wali jagah stroma se zyada wali jagah lumen mein ja raha hai, jo dhalaan ke ulta hai. Toh is ulte safar ki energy kahan se aati hai?
Is ulte safar ki energy electron ke apne safar se aati hai. Z scheme mein electron neeche ki taraf jaate hue jo energy chhodta tha, uska ek hissa yahan kaam aata hai.
Toh doosri wajah yeh hai: electrons jab photosystems se guzarte hain, tab protons membrane ke paar, stroma se lumen mein, pahunchaaye jaate hain.
Cyclic raaste mein bhi electron PQ aur B6f se hokar P700 par lautta hai, isliye wahan bhi H⁺ lumen mein pahunchte hain. Isi wajah se cyclic flow bhi ATP bana paata hai.
[p011-i21]
Ab teesri wajah, jo electron ke safar ke aakhri kadam par milti hai.
PS I ke acceptor se electrons Fd ke raaste FNR tak aate hain, yaani NADP reductase enzyme tak.
Yeh enzyme membrane ki stroma side par laga hai, yaani membrane ke us chehre par jo stroma ki taraf hai.
Yaad karo, reduction mein molecule electrons leta hai. Yahan NADP⁺ electrons lekar NADPH banta hai.
Par is badlav ke liye sirf electrons kaafi nahi, ek H⁺ bhi chahiye: NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH.
Electrons Fd se aate hain, aur enzyme bas unhe NADP⁺ se jodne mein madad karta hai.
Enzyme stroma ki taraf laga hai, isliye yeh H⁺ bhi stroma se hi liye jaate hain.
Ab yaad rakho ki gradient andar ke H⁺ aur bahar ke H⁺ ka fark hai.
Yeh H⁺ lumen mein gaya hi nahi, stroma mein hi NADPH ke saath jud gaya. Ruko, pehle khud socho: phir bhi isse gradient kaise badhta hai?
Aapne socha hoga ki fark sirf andar badhane se nahi, bahar ghatane se bhi badhta hai.
Gradient isliye badhta hai kyunki stroma ke H⁺ NADPH banne mein kharch ho gaye, aur bahar H⁺ kam reh gaye.
Jaise dam ke neeche ki nadi se kisaan nahar mein paani nikaal lein, toh deewaar ke dono taraf ka fark aur badh jaata hai.
Toh teesri wajah yeh hai: NADP⁺ ki reduction ke liye zaroori protons bhi stroma se hataaye jaate hain.
Dhyaan do, yahan H⁺ ek taraf se doosri taraf le jaaya nahi gaya; woh stroma mein hi kharch hua.
[example]
Ab teeno wajahon ko ek saath gino, do paani ke molecules se shuru karke.
Do H₂O se chaar electron, chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ bane. Yeh chaar H⁺ seedhe lumen mein gaye.
Wahi chaar electron aage do PQ par chadhe. Do PQ ne stroma se chaar H⁺ uthaye, do PQH₂ bane, aur yeh chaar H⁺ bhi lumen mein chhoote.
Aakhir mein wahi chaar electron do NADP⁺ ko do NADPH banate hain. Har NADPH ne stroma ka ek H⁺ liya, toh stroma se do H⁺ aur ghate.
Ab in teen wajahon ki ginti jodo: lumen mein chaar aur chaar, yaani aath H⁺ jude.
Stroma se chaar aur do, yaani chhe H⁺ ghate.
Yeh ginti sirf ek O₂ banne tak ki hai. Light jab tak milti rahe, yeh ginti baar-baar judti rehti hai, aur andar-bahar ka fark badhta jaata hai.
[p011-i22]
Toh teeno wajahon ka nateeja ek hi hai. Chloroplast ke andar stroma mein protons ki ginti ghatti hai, aur lumen mein protons jama hote jaate hain.
Isse thylakoid membrane ke aar-paar proton gradient ban jaata hai.
Dhyaan do, yeh fark thylakoid ki membrane ke aar-paar hai, chloroplast ki bahari deewaar ke aar-paar nahi.
H⁺ ki zyada maatra ka ek aur asar bhi hai. Nimbu ka ras khatta lagta hai, kyunki usmein H⁺ bahut zyada hote hain.
Koi ghol kitna acidic, yaani khatta, hai, yeh pH naam ke scale se naapte hain. Saaf paani ka pH 7 hota hai, aur acidic ghol ka 7 se kam.
Aksar hum sochte hain ki zyada H⁺ matlab zyada pH, par aisa nahi hai. H⁺ jitne zyada hote hain, pH utna kam hota hai.
Isliye lumen mein H⁺ jama hone se uska pH ghat jaata hai, aur yeh kami naapi bhi ja sakti hai.
[p011-i23, p011-i24]
Humne itni mehnat se H⁺ ko lumen mein jama hote dekha. Par sirf H⁺ jama karne se toh ATP abhi tak nahi bana.
Toh sawaal uthta hai ki hum is proton gradient mein itni dilchaspi kyun le rahe hain?
Proton gradient mein hum itni dilchaspi isliye lete hain, kyunki isi gradient ke tootne se ATP banta hai.
Gradient tootne ka matlab hai dono taraf ke fark ka kam hona.
Aksar lagta hai ki gradient tootne par protons khatam ho jaate hain, par aisa nahi hai. Woh bas zyada wali taraf se kam wali taraf laut aate hain.
Lumen ke H⁺ membrane paar karke stroma mein waapas jaate hain, jaise gubbare ki hawa munh khulte hi bahar aati hai.
Par membrane H⁺ ko kahin se bhi nikalne nahi deti. Woh ek khaas raaste se hi guzar paate hain, jo membrane ke aar-paar faila hai.
Trans ka matlab aar-paar hai. Jo membrane ke ek taraf se doosri taraf tak faila ho, use transmembrane kehte hain.
Dam mein bhi paani sirf deewaar ki nali se girta hai; ab is transmembrane raaste ko kholte hain.
[p012-i1]
Yeh transmembrane raasta usi ATP synthase mein hai, jise humne figure ki daayi taraf dekha tha. ATP synthase enzyme ke do hisse hain.
Pehla hissa CF₀ hai, jo thylakoid membrane mein dhansa hua hai. Yeh membrane ke aar-paar ek channel banata hai, aur yahi woh transmembrane channel hai.
Naam mein C chloroplast ko batata hai. Mitochondria mein isi tarah ki machine ke hisson ko F₀ aur F₁ kehte hain.
Ab diffusion yaad karo. Kamre ke kone mein agarbatti jalao, toh khushboo zyada wali jagah se kam wali jagah apne-aap phail jaati hai.
H⁺ par charge hai, isliye woh membrane ki charbi jaisi lipid parat se seedhe nahi nikal paata.
CF₀ ka channel use raasta deta hai. H⁺ is raaste se apni dhalaan ke saath, zyada se kam ki taraf, beh jaata hai.
Kisi protein raaste ki madad se, dhalaan ke saath aur bina alag energy lagaye paar jaane ko facilitated diffusion kehte hain. Facilitated ka matlab hai madad paaya hua.
Toh CF₀ ek transmembrane channel hai, jo membrane ke aar-paar protons ka facilitated diffusion karata hai.
Doosra hissa CF₁ hai. Yeh thylakoid membrane ki bahar wali satah par, stroma ki taraf, ubhra hua hai.
CF₁ stroma ki taraf hai, isliye usmein bana ATP seedha stroma mein hi milta hai.
Dam ki tasveer mein CF₀ deewaar ki nali aur turbine hai, aur CF₁ upar laga generator.
[p012-i2]
Ab dekho ki H⁺ ke bahne se ATP banne ki energy kaise aati hai.
Gubbare se nikalti hawa haath ko dhakka deti hai. Isi tarah dhalaan ke saath bahte H⁺ bhi energy chhodte hain.
Gradient ke tootne se itni energy milti hai ki ATP synthase ke CF₁ particle ki banawat badal jaati hai.
Protein ki teen-dimensional banawat ko conformation kehte hain, aur is banawat ke badalne ko conformational change.
Jab H⁺ CF₀ se guzarte hain, toh uska ek hissa turbine ki tarah ghoomta hai, aur yahi ghoomna CF₁ ki shape badalta hai.
CF₁ ke andar ATP banane ki teen jagahein hain. Shape badalne par koi jagah ADP aur Pᵢ ko pakadti hai, koi unhe dabakar jod deti hai, aur koi bana ATP chhod deti hai.
Is badlav se enzyme energy se bhare, yaani energy-packed, ATP ke kai molecules bana deta hai.
Dhyaan do, ATP mein ADP aur Pᵢ jude hain; electron is jodne mein kahin shaamil nahi hai.
[p012-i3]
Ab poori baat ek jagah samet lo. Chemiosmosis ke liye chaar cheezein chahiye: ek membrane, ek proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase.
Membrane H⁺ ko ek taraf roke rakhti hai, jaise dam ki deewaar paani ko.
Jo energy lagakar H⁺ ko kam wali taraf se zyada wali taraf pahunchaata hai, use proton pump kehte hain. Thylakoid mein yeh kaam H carrier aur cytochrome B6f milkar karte hain.
Dhalaan ke ulta chalne mein energy lagti hai, jaise motor bijli lekar paani chhat ki tanki tak chadhati hai. Yahan yeh energy light se excited electron ke safar se aati hai.
Is energy se protons membrane ke paar pump hote hain, aur thylakoid lumen mein H⁺ ki oonchi maatra, yaani gradient, ban jaati hai.
Thylakoid lumen thylakoid thaili ke andar ki wahi jagah hai, jise hum ab tak lumen keh rahe the.
ATP synthase ka channel protons ko membrane ke paar waapas diffuse hone deta hai.
Is lautne se itni energy nikalti hai ki ATP synthase enzyme sakriya ho jaata hai, aur ATP banne ki reaction ko catalyse karta hai, yaani tezi se karata hai.
[checkpoint]
Humne dekha ki membrane H⁺ ko lumen mein roke rakhti hai, aur H⁺ sirf CF₀ ke raaste laut paate hain.
Ab socho, phir aage badhenge: agar thylakoid membrane mein chhote-chhote ched ho jaayen, toh light aur electron ki daud chalte rehne par bhi kya ATP banega?
Membrane mein ched hone par ATP nahi banega, kyunki H⁺ CF₀ ke bajay chedon se laut jaayenge, aur lumen mein fark ban hi nahi paayega.
Electron tab bhi carriers mein daud sakte hain, lekin unki mehnat ATP tak nahi pahunchegi.
Dam ki deewaar mein daraar ho, toh paani turbine ghumaaye bina beh jaata hai, aur bijli nahi banti.
Isliye membrane, pump, gradient aur ATP synthase, in chaaron mein se ek bhi na ho, toh chemiosmosis nahi chalta.
[p012-i4]
Ab poori kahani shuru se ek baar jodo.
Light se excited electron PS II se chalkar PQ, B6f aur PC ke raaste PS I tak, aur phir Fd aur FNR se NADP⁺ tak jaata hai.
Raaste mein teen kaam hote hain: water splitting lumen mein H⁺ deti hai, PQ stroma se H⁺ uthakar lumen mein chhodta hai, aur NADPH banne mein stroma ke H⁺ kharch hote hain.
Nateeja yeh hai ki lumen mein H⁺ zyada aur pH kam ho jaata hai, aur stroma mein H⁺ kam reh jaate hain.
Phir H⁺ CF₀ ke channel se stroma mein laut aate hain, CF₁ ki shape badalti hai, aur ADP aur Pᵢ se ATP banta hai.
Toh electron ki daud ATP isliye bana deti hai, kyunki woh pehle H⁺ ka fark banati hai, aur us fark ka lautna ATP synthase ko chalaata hai.
Ab dekho, yeh ATP aur electrons ke safar se bana NADPH, dono membrane ki stroma wali taraf hi bante hain.
Wahin stroma mein inka turant istemaal hota hai, us biosynthetic reaction mein jo CO₂ ko fix karti hai aur sugars banati hai.
Bio yaani jeevan aur synthesis yaani banana; biosynthetic reaction jeevit cell mein naye molecule banane wali reaction hai.
CO₂ fix karna yaani hawa ki CO₂ ke carbon ko ek organic molecule mein pakka jod dena.
Yeh reactions kaise chalti hain, yeh aage dekhenge. Abhi bas itna jaan lo ki unhe ATP se energy aur NADPH se electrons milte hain.
Jaise dam ki bijli taaron se ghar pahunchkar kaam aati hai, waise hi ATP aur NADPH stroma mein sugar banane ke kaam aate hain.
